notes: This fixture was expanded from a sentinel fixture toward the full 117-item Regulation M-A legal item list.
MetaVGC is treated as the primary legal snapshot; RotomPicks provides category/count cross-checks; Serebii is retained as a cross-check source; ChampDex is contextual guidance.
Champions legality and local damage-engine support are intentionally modeled as separate concepts.
PokeAPI item metadata and existing repo static item files are metadata/effect-support fallback only, not Champions legality sources.
Damage-supported but not confirmed Champions-legal items remain in damage_supported_non_legal_items and must not be exposed as normal legal selector entries.
